call_name.description: Called name used to disambiguate multiple calls on one source line.

ground_truth.description: Target function id, external callee, or unknown target.

measured_edge.description: Resolved target function id; null when unresolved.

function_id.description: Sampled caller function id, used for depth comparison.

module.description: Caller module used to restrict depth to within-module edges.

ground_truth_module.description: Target module for a ground-truth edge.

measured_module.description: Target module for a measured edge.
